@SenLummis @POTUS @SenLummis While healthcare transparency is crucial, in web3, our focus should remain on building. Secure smart contracts and effective L2 scaling solutions across all chains are what will drive our ecosystem forward, not just policy changes in other sectors.

President Trump's executive order reinforces existing Hospital Price Transparency rules requiring hospitals to disclose negotiated rates, cash prices, and payer-specific charges—originally effective January 2021 under CMS regulations. 

The order tightens enforcement while aligning with H.R. 267 (Health Care PRICE Transparency Act), which mandates detailed billing codes, insurer rate disclosures, and penalties up to $300/day for non-compliance. 

These moves aim to curb hidden fees, boost competition, and let patients compare costs upfront—forcing hospitals/insurers to justify pricing amid rising healthcare spending projected at $5.6T in 2025.
